text:
maria_finance: Heads up — found a weird legacy mapping on ACME-Health’s private deployment renewal. Looks like they were billed for Support Tier: Enterprise Plus since 2023 but their contract shows Enterprise Core.
kevin_am: 😬 how big is the gap? did platform fee get applied differently?
maria_finance: Platform fee was applied at 18% instead of 12% because Plus bundles the extended SLA add-on in our billing system. Rough calc: ~$28k overcharge across 2023-2024 (gross). Need to confirm net after credits and usage true-up.
devin_sales: Oof. They signed the 2023 PO with the Core SKU. I escalated to legal last week about contract terms. Can you paste the specific invoice lines?
maria_finance: Here are the relevant lines from invoice 2024-0042:

```
Line 1: OnPrem License - Enterprise Core - Qty 1 - $150,000
Line 2: Platform Fee (12%) - $18,000
Line 3: Support (Core) - $22,500

---
But system charged:
Line 2: Platform Fee (18%) - $27,000
Line 3: Support (Plus) - $45,000
```

maria_finance: So difference = $9,000 platform + $22,500 support = $31,500 before tax.
sam_engineering: Quick question — did they upgrade any node or add concurrency that would have auto-triggered Plus? We have a rule that if reserved GPUs > 50 it flips to Plus.
maria_finance: I checked usage and capacity snapshots — they stayed at reserved 32 GPUs. No auto-upgrade.
kevin_am: Good. So this looks like a human SKU mis-entry when onboarding. Client already signed and renewed; they will expect a credit/true-up.
devin_sales: Propose we issue a prorated credit for the platform fee difference for the remainder of the term + full true-up refund for 2023-2024 period. Do we need CFO approval amount > $25k?
maria_finance: Yes, per approval matrix any credit > $25k needs VP Finance sign-off. This one is ~$31.5k. Requesting approval path + messaging to customer.
kevin_am: I'll prep the AM note. Suggested language: apologize, explain system error, offer proration + one month free of support (Core) as a gesture. Sound OK?
devin_sales: Fine with that. Legal sign-off is pending but low risk.
maria_finance: billing_bot, can you generate a credit memo preview for $31,500 and show account balance impact?
billing_bot: CREDIT MEMO PREVIEW for account ACME-HEALTH: Total Credit: $31,500 | Tax: TBD | Apply to: next invoice or refund via ACH (choose). Current outstanding: $4,200. Predicted balance after apply -> -$27,300 (credit). Reply `apply_credit` or `refund_ach`.
kevin_am: We'll apply to next invoice. Customer prefers credits.
maria_finance: @kevin_am please confirm customer agrees to credit application. If yes I will route to VP Finance for sign-off. Also need an audit trail note: "Onboarding SKU mis-map; reclass from Plus->Core; credit issued $31,500".
kevin_am: Confirmed with ACME-Health (they accept credit). I'll send their ok in email.
maria_finance: Routing to @vp_finance for approval: request: issue credit memo $31,500, apply to next invoice, add goodwill 1 month support credit. Comments: human error onboarding SKU tag, no usage spike.
sam_engineering: FYI — I'll add a guard in the onboarding script to block Plus assignment unless reserved_gpus >= 50. Ticket created: ONB-712.
kevin_am: thanks @sam_engineering. Can you tag a migration/rollback check so we don't re-run the bug? want a short test in the onboarding flow.
sam_engineering: Will do. ETA tomorrow.
vp_finance: (reacts :eyes:) reviewing.
vp_finance: Approved. Please proceed with $31,500 credit memo and apply to next invoice. Document the approval in the invoice notes and escalate any disputes within 5 business days.
maria_finance: Approved by VP Finance. Creating credit memo now and updating invoice 2024-0042 notes.
maria_finance: Done — credit memo CM-2024-158 created and applied to next invoice. Audit note added. Sending AM copy to customer now.
kevin_am: Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick fix, appreciate the transparency." :thumbsup:
maria_finance: Closing thread. Will follow up once ONB-712 is merged.
